description: Run the safety check on a job without running it: rules, then one review. Use it when unsure. Never send a job that mines, scans, attacks or reaches for the network (it has none); reads or writes outside its own folder or looks for keys, passwords, tokens or wallets; hides what it does (base64 or packed payloads, eval of built text, binaries instead of source); keeps running after it ends; or carries anyone's secrets (the machine's owner may read every byte). Every job is checked before it runs and again by the machine that runs it; a refused job counts against your account, clean jobs earn it higher limits.

command.description: argv, e.g. ["python3", "sim.py"]; never a shell string

files.description: relative path -> text content, put in the job folder (source only, no binaries)

public.description: true lets any machine on the network run it, including ones that joined self-serve; leave false for work you would not show a stranger

result_path.description: file the job writes its answer to, default result.json; it comes back as output

timeout_s.description: seconds, default 120; the cap depends on your account's level (compute_backends)

name: compute_check
title: Check a job before sending it
